scope: Original eighteen internal cases plus fixed source, usage, integration, consolidation, calendar and scenario failure cases. Fictional local data and scripted providers only. Excludes changing CP-SAT implementation and representative model, customer or production acceptance.

cases.title: Remember reviewed meanings
cases.expected_behavior: Reuse saved descriptions and preserve answered definitions instead of asking the same review again.

cases.title: Keep personal context private and source-bound
cases.expected_behavior: Only the owner's authorized goal and current-upload notes reach planning; other-upload notes do not substitute for current context.

cases.title: Ask for the actual missing unit
cases.expected_behavior: A requested measure with no unit is not replaced by another measure; missing details are asked even when model exploration is empty.

cases.title: Offer honest alternatives without dates
cases.expected_behavior: Chat and forecasts agree that a time forecast needs dates; explicit daily assumptions retain exact results and warn rather than clip negative values.

cases.title: Repair one invalid reading within unchanged validation
cases.expected_behavior: A malformed or twenty-field invalid reading gets one bounded correction without loosening the no-invented-numbers checks.

cases.title: Stop repeated invalid replies honestly
cases.expected_behavior: After two invalid returned replies, use explicit fallback and ask a real missing question rather than looping or publishing unchecked model prose.

cases.title: Keep correction inside budget and deadline
cases.expected_behavior: Enforce the shared deadline and call budget; caller cancellation stops correction work.

cases.title: Refuse changed source or meaning before publication
cases.expected_behavior: A changed reading revision or group-comparison source cannot publish stale results, and accepted refresh changes retain their source-changed failure reason.

cases.title: Stop disclosure after permission revocation
cases.expected_behavior: Revocation blocks correction or fallback disclosure and prevents a new allocation recommendation from publishing.

cases.title: Distinguish pooled and within-group relationships
cases.expected_behavior: Match independent Pearson and tied-rank oracles on balanced and uneven groups; highlight only directions that meet the declared display rule.

cases.title: Compare the same eligible rows
cases.expected_behavior: Missing, sparse and constant exclusions are disjoint; pooled scores use exactly eligible groups' complete pairs, and constant groups do not become zero-correlation evidence.

cases.title: Preserve exact ranks and complete populations
cases.expected_behavior: Float collapse withholds Pearson while valid Spearman remains; more than ten thousand matching rows is refused instead of silently sampled.

cases.title: Respect chosen fields and row restrictions
cases.expected_behavior: Ambiguous or filtered group requests clarify, stale clarification cannot execute, and the durable path uses one owner-private projection receipt.

cases.title: Verify exact constrained decisions independently
cases.expected_behavior: One- and two-resource rule selections match an independent exhaustive rational oracle, including exact ties and infeasible cases.

cases.title: Keep conflicts and the do-nothing baseline explicit
cases.expected_behavior: Conflicts may disable optional actions; contradictory mandatory rules yield infeasibility and refuse approval, while feasible zero-budget do-nothing stays available.

cases.title: Reject a corrupted solver proposal
cases.expected_behavior: The independent checker catches invalid quantities and selection-rule violations, and failed verification withholds a recommendation.

cases.title: Reopen private evidence and preserve older methods
cases.expected_behavior: New grouped and daily evidence replays exactly with owner privacy; absent new allocation rules preserve old one- and two-resource request/result serialization.

cases.title: Cancel computation and publication cleanly
cases.expected_behavior: Group computation cleanup finishes on cancellation; cancellation after pattern calculation clears unpublished answer evidence while retaining the private receipt.

cases.title: Retain complete exact source snapshots
cases.expected_behavior: A SELECT-only source yields exact retained values; concurrent commits do not mix snapshots and source rows remain unchanged.

cases.title: Publish source imports atomically
cases.expected_behavior: Idempotent requests publish once, revoked authority publishes nothing and uncertain commits retain referenced bytes.

cases.title: Bound source extraction work
cases.expected_behavior: A slow source lock or exhausted shared deadline fails safely without producing a partial snapshot.

cases.title: Reserve usage without oversubscription
cases.expected_behavior: Concurrent admission and repeated settlement preserve explicit limits and exact single accounting.

cases.title: Preserve unknown model exposure
cases.expected_behavior: Missing counts or prices never become zero cost; only evidence-backed operator reconciliation settles unknown exposure.

cases.title: Keep scoped keys within issuer authority
cases.expected_behavior: A key cannot impersonate another member, become a session, revive after rejoining or bypass current dataset policy.

cases.title: Bind embeds to host and current access
cases.expected_behavior: The declared host, single-use bootstrap and current permissions stay enforced without exposing secrets.

cases.title: Bound signed metadata delivery
cases.expected_behavior: Actual local transport receives signed metadata only after commit, and retries retain identity and stop after the declared limit.

cases.title: Preserve declared consolidation layers
cases.expected_behavior: Complete mappings, exact rates and explicit eliminations reproduce saved worksheets, including large decimal values.

cases.title: Recheck every company before release
cases.expected_behavior: Other members cannot open private worksheets, policy changes prevent publication and export revocation discards rendered output.

cases.title: Keep seasonal references chronological
cases.expected_behavior: Independent rational calculations match findings; later data never refits earlier scores and zero spread is explicit.

cases.title: Keep distribution evidence exact
cases.expected_behavior: Independent quantile oracles cover unequal samples; repeating decimals remain marked approximate and variance changes stay visible.

cases.title: Protect chronological result publication
cases.expected_behavior: Policy changes during computation publish nothing and historical saved results retain their original meaning.

cases.title: Keep explicit scenario populations and basis
cases.expected_behavior: Per-row products retain exact results; required filters share one population and source-policy changes prevent publication.
